verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken right column. The 'Try It' button touches the bottom of the product circle and sits close to the bottom edge, and 'Out now.' has been pulled away from the headline it belongs to and parked beside the button, which breaks the grouping and the reading order. A keeps the headline on one strong line that has more presence, though it crowds the circle a little. B wraps the headline onto two lines at a smaller size, leaving it weaker and the middle of the canvas emptier.
